blind.description: A square-profile stylized dressed-stone corner pillar or wall post constructed from stacked stone blocks. Adjacent faces feature vertical recessed grooves or stylized arrow slits, and the top is crowned with a slightly flared, four-part low pyramidal stone cap. Materials are solid, clean, and textured in warm brownish-grey stone with greenish tints in the seams.
blind.from_above: A square stone cap divided symmetrically into four quadrants that rise gently toward a low central peak.
blind.height_vs_figure: About two-thirds the height of the figure (roughly 3.5 to 4 feet tall) and around 1.5 feet wide.
